summary: This Form 8-K reports Janus Living, Inc.'s closing of a registered underwritten public offering of 25,000,000 shares of Class A-1 common stock at $0.01 par value per share, with an underwriter option for an additional 3,750,000 shares. The underwriting agreement involves the company, its operating company, external manager, and underwriters including BofA Securities. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is present; it is a routine capital raise. No price per share, premium, or special conditions are disclosed beyond the share count and par value.
